timeline.title: $4.39-million three-year support announced
timeline.short_description: The Province named New Roads and estimated the support would reach 330 people over three years.

timeline.title: Island Health lists New Roads
timeline.short_description: The health-authority service directory identifies New Roads among current community bed-based treatment and recovery options.

timeline.title: 20-bed women’s facility opens
timeline.short_description: An official opening notice documents a distinct 20-bed women’s therapeutic-recovery facility connected to New Roads.
timeline.organization: Government of British Columbia and Our Place Society

timeline.title: Operator maintains current program information
timeline.short_description: Our Place Society’s New Roads site provides current program and access information.

dossiers.subject: Creekside Withdrawal Management Centre — Road to Recovery expansion

timeline.title: Road to Recovery launched in Vancouver
timeline.short_description: The Province described a standardized access-and-treatment model supported by $23.7 million in annual program funding.

timeline.title: Provincewide Road to Recovery expansion announced
timeline.short_description: The Province announced nearly $154 million over three years for 100 beds, outpatient services and regional access lines.

timeline.title: Road to Recovery utilization reported
timeline.short_description: The Ministry’s annual report provides call and bed-access measures for the wider model, not a Creekside-only outcome assessment.

timeline.title: Ten added Creekside beds reported operational
timeline.short_description: Fraser Health named Creekside, the added bed count and related implementation supports.

dossiers.subject: Saskatchewan First Nations Health Ombudsperson Office — governance and funding

timeline.title: Chiefs-in-Assembly resolution establishes mandate
timeline.short_description: The office identifies FSIN Chiefs-in-Assembly Resolution 2046 as the basis for its First Nations governance authority.
timeline.organization: Federation of Sovereign Indigenous Nations Chiefs-in-Assembly

timeline.title: $1.17-million first-year establishment funding announced
timeline.short_description: Indigenous Services Canada announced contribution funding for FSIN to establish the office.

timeline.title: $775,000 agreement disclosed
timeline.short_description: Federal proactive disclosure identifies the recipient, value and term but not detailed activity-level spending.
timeline.organization: Indigenous Services Canada and First Nations Health Ombudsperson Office

timeline.title: Office and annual reporting remain available
timeline.short_description: The FNHO site describes current operation and provides an annual-report registry.

dossiers.subject: In Plain Sight — implementation and public-reporting accountability

timeline.title: In Plain Sight final report and recommendations
timeline.short_description: The independent review documented findings and issued 24 recommendations concerning Indigenous-specific racism in B.C. health care.

timeline.title: FNHA publishes one-year update
timeline.short_description: FNHA reported anti-racism, cultural-safety and humility work one year after In Plain Sight.

timeline.title: Province issues 24-month update
timeline.short_description: The official update described implementation activity connected to the recommendations.

timeline.title: Estimates notes document specific implementation examples
timeline.short_description: The official notes describe recommendation-level activity including governance, complaint, professional-standard, legislative and training work.

timeline.title: Action 3.07 reports progress and a coverage limitation
timeline.short_description: The current action page identifies implementation activity while stating that the framework does not comprehensively report all 24 recommendations.
